description: The MH-19 RTO serves the Jalgaon district in the state of Maharashtra, functioning as a primary hub for vehicle registration and licensing. It handles a high volume of agricultural and commercial vehicle documentation given Jalgaon's status as a major producer of bananas and gold trading.
address: Plot No. 7, Adarsh Nagar, Near SP Chowk, Ganapati Nagar, Jalgaon, Maharashtra
